en: A black‑and‑white vintage view of a narrow historic street lined with tall brick buildings in Bruges. An ornate arched passageway with statues and decorative gables connects the buildings above the street. People in early 20th‑century clothing, including women with long dresses and hats and children, walk along the street. Printed caption text and numbering appear at the bottom of the image, suggesting it is a commercial postcard.
